subject: Follow-up: Private VPC architecture review - scheduling and prep
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 06:45:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Private VPC architecture review - scheduling and prep

Hi Alex - thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of prep items before we lock the architecture review: 

Recap:
- Fintegrate is evaluating a Private (VPC) deployment for low-latency customer inference.
- Main concerns: connectivity (VPC peering vs VPN), data residency, audit logging (SOC2), and KMS integration.

Proposed next step:
- 75-minute Private/VPC architecture review + technical deep dive with our SEs to cover topology, connectivity options, and firewall/KMS requirements.

Available slots (PT):
- Tue Mar 29, 2028 - 10:00-11:15 PT
- Wed Mar 30, 2028 - 14:00-15:15 PT

Prep request:
- Please upload any network diagrams (VPC/subnets/CIDRs), NAT/egress IPs, and a preliminary list of firewall rules to the Drive link below so our team can review ahead of the call.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleLink

Attached: a short agenda and SOC2 evidence checklist. Once you confirm a slot I'll send the invite and include Marissa and Nikhil from our SE team.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- 20280325-discovery-agenda.pdf (1 page)
- soc2-evidence-stub.zip (index of evidence files)

1) Please confirm the call will cover VPC peering and VPN tradeoffs and performance impact.
2) We will upload our network diagram and a list of NAT/egress IPs to the Drive by EOD Monday so your SEs can review.

Looping Priya so she can add anyone else from infra/security. Please go ahead and send the invite for Tue 10:00 PT.

Thanks,

Thanks Alex - confirmed Tue Mar 29, 2028 at 10:00 PT for a 75-minute session. I've copied Marissa (Lead SE) and Nikhil (Infra SE) to lead the deep dive.

Brief agenda:
- Intros & goals (5-10m)
- Fintegrate topology & constraints (Priya) (15m)
- Deployment options: VPC Peering vs VPN vs Private Link (Marissa) (25m)
- Firewall/ports & KMS considerations (Nikhil) (20m)
- Q&A & next steps (15m)

Alex - if you can drop the diagrams and IP lists in the Drive link earlier that helps us prepare. Invite to follow.

Best,
Aditya
